dashboard.title: Dashboard

guests.title: Guests
guests.archiveConfirm: Archive this guest? They will be hidden from lists but their history is kept.

import.title: Import guests from CSV
import.intro: Upload a CSV file (UTF-8, e.g. exported from Excel or Google Sheets). The first row must contain column names.
import.columnsList: name_en, name_kh, phone, email, category, side, relationship, group, notes
import.categoryHelp: category: groom_family, bride_family, friend, colleague, vip, other. side: groom, bride, both. group: a family name — guests with the same group name are put in one family group.
import.fixAndRetry: Fix these rows in your file and preview again. Nothing is imported until every row is valid.

groups.title: Families & groups
groups.nameHint: Shown on the invitation, e.g. “The Chan Family”.
groups.memberCount: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}}
groups.removeConfirm: Remove this person from the group? They stay in your guest list.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.capacityHint: Maximum number of people who may attend.
invitations.allowUnnamedHint: Lets the invitee bring people who are not named in your guest list.
invitations.internalLabelHint: e.g. “Table 4” or “Office friends”. Never shown to guests.
invitations.noGuests: No guests available. Guests in a family group are invited through the group.
invitations.linkHidden: The link is hidden for privacy. Reveal it to copy or share.
invitations.revealed: Link revealed (recorded in the activity log)
invitations.rotateConfirm: Generate a new link? The current link and QR code will stop working immediately.
invitations.rotated: New link generated. Share it again with the guest.
invitations.deactivateConfirm: Temporarily disable this invitation? The link will show “no longer active” until you activate it again.
invitations.revokeConfirm: Permanently revoke this invitation? The link stops working and this cannot be undone. You can create a new invitation for this guest afterwards.
invitations.rsvpDeadlineHint: Optional. Overrides the site-wide deadline (Phnom Penh time).
invitations.shareHint: Send this link privately (Telegram, Messenger…). Anyone with the link can see this invitation.
invitations.overrideAdd: Enter a reply for this guest
invitations.overrideReasonHint: e.g. “Guest phoned to confirm”. Saved in the history.

security.title: Security
security.newPasswordHint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence works well.
security.changed: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
security.othersSignedOut: {count, plural, =0 {No other devices} one {# device signed out} other {# devices signed out}}
security.sharedAccount: This is a shared account for both of you. The activity log records actions by the shared account and cannot tell which of you performed them.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.sharedNote: Actions are recorded for the shared couple account; individual partners cannot be distinguished.

content.title: Wedding details
content.intro: Names, date, messages and what the invitation shows. Nothing is shown to guests until you fill it in.
content.weddingDateHint: Phnom Penh time. Drives the countdown.
content.invitationMessageHint: Shown under your names on the invitation.
content.postWeddingMessageHint: Replaces the countdown once the date has passed.
content.contactsHint: Shown in the footer and when a link no longer works.
content.missingTranslation: Only one language filled in — the other language will show this text.
content.imageHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to {maxMb} MB.
content.storyIntro: Introductions, how you met, your journey and milestones.
content.deleteConfirm: Delete this item? This cannot be undone.
content.rsvpDeadlineHint: Phnom Penh time. After it, guests can no longer change their reply (you still can).
content.rsvpAllowMaybeHint: Lets guests answer Maybe as well as Yes or No.
content.wishesPublicEnabledHint: Guests can send wishes. You approve each one before it is shown.
content.giftEvidenceEnabledHint: Guests may attach a screenshot when telling you about a gift. Only you can see it.
content.unsavedImage: New file not saved yet — press Save to keep it.
content.musicHint: MP3 or M4A, up to 15 MB. Starts when a guest taps “Open invitation”; guests can pause it.

events.title: Schedule
events.intro: Ceremonies and receptions shown on the invitation, in time order.
events.dressCodeHint: e.g. Traditional Khmer attire, shades of purple welcome
events.instructionsHint: Arrival time, gifts, anything guests should know.

locations.title: Venues
locations.intro: Places shown with maps and directions.
locations.eventCount: {count, plural, =0 {No events} one {# event} other {# events}}
locations.name: Venue name
locations.mapUrlHint: Google Maps “Share” link. If empty, coordinates or the address are used.
locations.mapEmbedHint: Google Maps → Share → Embed a map → Copy HTML, then paste here.
locations.deleteConfirm: Delete this venue? If events use it, it will be archived instead so they keep their venue.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.intro: Pre-wedding albums. Choose who can see each album.
gallery.photoCount: {count, plural, =0 {No photos} one {# photo} other {# photos}}

visibilityHint.PUBLIC: Anyone who visits the gallery page.
visibilityHint.INVITATION_ONLY: Only people who opened a valid invitation link on this device.
visibilityHint.UNPUBLISHED: Only you, here in the admin area.

gallery.archiveConfirm: Archive this album? It is hidden from guests; photos are kept.
gallery.uploadHint: Select several photos at once (up to 50). JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to {maxMb} MB each.
gallery.noPhotos: No photos yet. Upload some to get started.
gallery.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# photo added} other {# photos added}}
gallery.caption: Caption
gallery.altTextHint: Describes the photo for people using screen readers.

wishes.title: Wishes
wishes.intro: Approve wishes before they appear on the invitation. Private wishes are only ever visible here.
wishes.archiveConfirm: Archive this wish? It disappears from all lists except Archived.
wishes.name: Name
wishes.editNote: The guest's original text is kept in the history.

payments.title: Gift details
payments.intro: KHQR codes and bank accounts shown on the gift page.
payments.verifyNote: Guests can only tell you they sent something. Always check your bank or KHQR app before marking a gift as received (Phase 6).
payments.label: Label
payments.instructionsHint: e.g. “Please write your name in the transfer note.”

gifts.title: Gifts received
gifts.intro: Private. Only gifts you confirm count in the totals. USD and KHR are always kept separate.
gifts.pendingCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to check} one {# gift to check} other {# gifts to check}}
gifts.contributorsHint: Invitations with at least one confirmed gift, plus confirmed gifts recorded without an invitation
gifts.evidenceNote: Private. A screenshot is not proof — always check your bank or KHQR app.
gifts.reasonHint: Required. Kept permanently in the history.
gifts.checkBankFirst: Check your bank or KHQR app first. Enter the amount you actually received.
gifts.rejectExplain: Mark this notification as not received (e.g. nothing arrived in the bank).
gifts.cancelExplain: Cancel this notification (e.g. a duplicate sent by mistake).
gifts.reopenExplain: Send this gift back to “To check”. It will no longer count in the totals.
gifts.cancelledNote: This notification was cancelled. It is kept for the record.
gifts.correctExplain: Fix the confirmed amount or details. The previous values stay in the history.
gifts.recordIntro: For cash received at the wedding or a transfer you already see in your bank.
gifts.confirmedNowHint: Counts in the totals immediately. Untick to keep it as “to check”.

checkin.title: Check-in
checkin.intro: Welcome guests on the day: scan the QR code on their invitation or search by name.
checkin.arrivedSummary: {guests, plural, =0 {No guests yet} one {# guest} other {# guests}} arrived · {parties, plural, one {# party} other {# parties}}
checkin.cameraIntro: Use the phone's back camera to scan the QR code printed on, or shown in, the guest's invitation.
checkin.cameraError: The camera could not start. Allow camera access in the browser, or use the name search below.
checkin.pointCamera: Point the camera at the QR code.
checkin.pausedHint: Scanning paused — finish this party first.
checkin.noParty: Scan a QR code or search for a name to see the invitation here.
checkin.notRecognised: This QR code is not recognised. Try searching by name.

inactive.INACTIVE: This invitation has been switched off. Check before welcoming.
inactive.REVOKED: This invitation was cancelled. Check before welcoming.

checkin.oldLink: This QR code is from an old link that has been replaced.
checkin.alreadyArrived: {count, plural, one {# guest} other {# guests}} from this party already arrived.
checkin.reasonHint: For example: second car arrived later
checkin.welcomed: {name} welcomed · {count, plural, one {# guest} other {# guests}}
checkin.undoExplain: Removes this arrival from the totals. The history is kept in the activity log.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.intro: How the invitations are going. Days are in Phnom Penh time. USD and KHR are always shown separately.
analytics.opensSubtitle: First opening of each invitation, link-preview bots excluded
analytics.giftsSubtitle: Running total of gifts you confirmed as received

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.intro: Download your data as Excel or CSV. Each download is recorded in the activity log.
downloads.privacyNote: Files contain personal information about your guests. Keep them private and delete them when no longer needed. Invitation links, gift screenshots and private notes are never included.

guests.title: Guests
guests.hint: Names, phone, category, family and relationship.

groups.title: Families & groups

invitations.hint: Who is invited, capacity, status and when the link was opened. Links are not included.

rsvps.title: Replies
rsvps.hint: Every reply with the number attending and named guests.

checkins.title: Arrivals
checkins.hint: Who arrived on the day, how many and when.

wishes.title: Wishes
wishes.hint: All wishes with their author and moderation status.

gifts.hint: Gifts with separate USD and KHR columns. Screenshots and private notes are not included.
